The winner of the Miss Venezuela 1970 pageant was Bella La Rosa, representing Carabobo. She won the title by chance as her twin sister Linda La Rosa had to withdraw from the competition after a horse fell and injured her. 

Here are some additional details about that year's results:
- 1st runner-up: Tomasita de las Casas (Miss Miranda)
- 2nd runner-up: Sonia Ledezma (Miss Monagas)
- 3rd runner-up: Peggy Romero (Miss Departamento Vargas), who was the first Afro-descendant to win a special award in this competition
- 4th runner-up: Marisela Berti (Miss Nueva Esparta)

Special awards were also given out:
- Miss Fotogénica (Best Photography): Marlene Agreda (Miss Aragua)
- Miss Amistad (Friendship): Reyna Noguera (Miss Guárico)
- Miss Cortesía (Courtesy): Peggy Romero (Miss Departamento Vargas) 
- Miss Sonrisa (Best Smile): Maigualida Leandro (Miss Bolívar)

The pageant was broadcast live on RCTV.
